description: See a design the way a person in the editor sees it: a PNG of the canvas with the overlays drawn on — the `selection` outline, the `reference` picture when one is attached, the discussion's `comments` pins, and the layout `bounds` — and beside it JSON with the revision, each visible node's id and box, each pin's thread and position, all in the returned image's pixels. The picture is a short-lived signed https link by default; `inline: true` puts the bytes in the reply as well. The frame is the PNG export (`renderer: "export"`, the editor's own renderer), which reports no node boxes; `renderer: "native"` draws real Compose on a host with a native render lane, reports every node's box so the selection can be outlined, and needs the ui-builder-export capability. With no `renderer`, a non-empty `selection` is drawn on the native frame when the host has a lane and the caller the capability, and otherwise on the export with a note saying why it is not outlined. A node with no box is reported in `notes`, never drawn at a guessed position. For a `wff-watchface` design, `frames` (2-12) over `durationMs`, or explicit `times`, draws the face at several instants instead — use it to check motion: a second hand's sweep, a seconds pulse, anything driven by `[SECOND_MILLISECOND]`, `[MILLISECOND]` or `[UTC_TIMESTAMP]` — and `ambient: true` draws ambient mode (alone: interactive and ambient side by side, to check the transition). The reply is one picture, by default a `filmstrip` grid with each frame labelled by its UTC time (`format: "animated"` makes an animated PNG), and `motion` lists each frame's time, box and hash, with `distinctFrames` saying whether anything moved. Frames are drawn by the editor's renderer on unsaved copies, at most 12 a call and 6 calls a minute per account; a design that pins `environment.fixedTime` shows that instant in every frame. It is an occasional look, not a per-edit check: `watchFaceCost` on each edit stays the per-edit cost signal. Not an McpResponseEnvelopeV1.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

ambient.description: wff-watchface only: draw the frames in ambient mode, applying the design's `wff/variant mode=AMBIENT` overrides. Alone, draws the interactive and ambient modes side by side.

durationMs.description: wff-watchface only: the window the frames cover, in milliseconds. Defaults to 1000.

format.description: With motion frames: `filmstrip` (default) is one labelled PNG grid, the easiest to read; `animated` is an animated PNG.

frames.description: wff-watchface only: draw this many frames spread evenly over `durationMs`, starting at the current whole second. Defaults to 6 when only `durationMs` is given.

include.description: Overlays to draw. Defaults to comments, reference, selection; [] draws the bare frame.

inline.description: Also return the PNG as an image block. Defaults to false; a host with no public origin always does.

renderer.description: Defaults to export, or native when a selection is to be outlined and this host and grant can render it.

revision.description: A past revision. Omit for the current one.

selection.description: Node ids to show as selected.

times.description: wff-watchface only: the exact instants to draw, in epoch milliseconds, instead of `frames` and `durationMs`.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

viewport.description: Fit the picture inside this many pixels, keeping its aspect ratio. Omit for the render's own size.

name: ui_builder_view
